γερουσία, -ας, ἡ 
 (γέρων), [in LXX (Hex. only in OT) for זָקֵן ;] 
a council of elders, senate; in NT, of the Sanhedrin (Cl. Rev., i, 43f.; DB, ext., 99): Act.5:21.†
 (AS)

ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό
 (ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 4Ki.25:19, Jer.29:26 52:25 (פָּקִיד), 2Ch.31:12 (נָגִיד), 2Ma.5:22, etc. ;] 
a chief, commander, master: Luk.5:5 8:24, 45 9:33, 49 17:13 (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).†
 (AS)

ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
 (ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2Ki.7:23 (יָרֵא), Est.5:1, Amo.5:22, 2Ma.2:21 2Mac 3:24 2Mac 5:4 2Mac 12:22 2Mac 14:16 2Mac 15:27, 3Ma.2:9 3Mac 5:8 3Mac 5:51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv) 
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2Th.2:8, 1Ti.6:14, 2Ti.1:10 4:1 4:8, Tit.2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†
 (AS)

ἄ-λαλος, -ον
 (λάλος, talkative), [in LXX: Psa.31:18 (אָלַם ni.) Psa.38:13 (אִלֵּם)* ;] 
dumb, speechless: Mrk.7:37 9:17, 25.†
 (AS)

Ἰσαάκ
 (in MSS. sometimes -σάκ; cf. Deiss., BS, 189; Thack., Gr., 100), ὁ 
indecl. 
 (in FlJ, Ἴσακος, -ου), (Heb. יִצְחָק), 
Isaac (Gen.17:19, al.): Mat.1:2, Rom.9:10, al 
 (AS)

κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
 (καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Isa.9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;] 
__1. exchange. 
 __2. reconciliation: Rom.5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rom.11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co.5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co.5:19.†
 (AS)

λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ
 (λυτρόω), [in LXX: Lev.25:29, 48, Isa.63:4 גְּאֻלָּה), Num.18:16, Psa.49:8 111:9 130:7 (פָּדָה, פִּדְיוֹם, פְּדוּת), Jdg.1:15 * ;] 
a ransoming, redemption (αἰχμαλώτων, Plut., Arat., 11): of the mediatorial work of Christ, Heb.9:12; in general sense, deliverance(cf. Psa.4:8, l.with): Luk.1:68 2:38.†
 (AS)

παρα-λέγω 
 to lay beside; mid., 
 __(a) to lie beside (Hom.); 
 __(b) later, of sailors, to sail past: with accusative, Act.27:8, 13.†
 (AS)

πραγματεύομαι
 (πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: 3Ki.10:22 B, 3Ki.9:19 A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;] 
__1. to busy oneself. 
 __2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Luk.19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†
 (AS)

σκέλος, -ους, τό 
 [in LXX for רֶגֶל, etc. ;] 
the leg from the hip downwards: ?Jhn.19:3-33 †
 (AS)

ἄγνοια, -ας, ἡ 
 (ἀγνοέω), [in LXX chiefly for אָשָׁם, שְׁגָגָה ;] 
ignorance : Act.3:17 17:30, Eph.4:18 (with sense of wilful blindness; cf. MM, VGT, see word), 1Pe.1:14.†
 (AS)

χορός, -οῦ, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for מָחוֹל, מְחֹלָה ;] 
a dance: pl., Luk.15:25.†
 (AS)

ἀρχι-τελώνης, -ου, ὁ 
 a chief tax-collector, chief publican: Luk.19:2.†
 (AS)

ἀ-στήρικτος, -ον
 (στηρίζω), 
unstable, unsettled: 2Pe.2:14 3:16.†
 (AS)

ἄφαντος, -ον
 (φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word) 
invisible, hidden: Luk.24:31.†
 (AS)

ἄχυρον, -ον, τό 
 [in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן ;] 
chaff: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17.†
 (AS)

βιβλίον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see), 
 [in LXX also in the alternat. form βυβ-, chiefly for סֶפֶר and the most frequently of the cognate forms ;] 
 __1. a paper, letter, written document: β. ἀποστασίου, bill of divorce, Mat.19:7, Mrk.10:4. 
 __2. a book, a roll: Luk.4:17, 20 Jhn.20:30 21:25, Gal.3:10, 2Ti.4:13, Heb.9:19 10:7, Rev.1:11 5:1-9 6:14 10:8 20:12 22:7-19; β. τ. ζωῆς, Rev.13:8 17:8 20:12 21:27.
† (AS)

a man, a certain (one)
